steps.say: Short bulbar narrowings are joined directly without grafts. Bulbar strictures under two cm are picked for excision. Transecting or non transecting repair is performed routinely. Spongiofibrosis must be limited for this choice alone. The urethra is mobilized for a tension free joint. Urethral length is preserved by careful dissection always.
steps.tx: **Excision and primary anastomosis** (cut and rejoin repair), **EPA** (end to end reconstruction), suits bulbar strictures under **2 cm** (two centimetres) without dense spongiofibrosis, with success above **90%** (ninety in a hundred). Mobilize the urethra for a tension free spatulated joint. Avoid transection where length is short, because chordee follows shortening.

steps.say: Longer defects are bridged using borrowed lining. Strictures beyond two cm are bridged with grafts. Penile urethral disease is never cut and rejoined together. Buccal mucosa is harvested from the cheek routinely. The graft is settled onto a well vascularized bed. Substitution urethroplasty is planned for every long case.
steps.tx: **Substitution urethroplasty** (graft bridge repair) with **buccal mucosa graft** (cheek lining), **BMG** (mouth graft), rebuilds strictures longer than **2 cm** (over two centimetres) and all penile urethral disease. Harvest cheek with care for the salivary duct. Quilt the graft onto its bed without tension, because haematoma beneath lifts grafts.

steps.say: Dorsal grafting is trusted to give the strongest bed. The Barbagli technique is laid onto the corpora. Buccal mucosa is fixed to tunica albuginea directly. The cavernosal bed is tapped to feed the graft richly. Take is rated excellent in most reported series. Ventral spongiosum is left undisturbed throughout.
steps.tx: **Barbagli technique** (dorsal graft repair) lays the **dorsal onlay** (top side graft) onto **tunica albuginea** (cavernosal coat) of the corpora for a stable vascular bed with excellent take. Open the strictured plate dorsally and quilt widely. Spare the dorsal nerves while exposing, because sensation matters lifelong.

steps.say: The belly side is picked for proximal bulbar repairs. Ventral onlay is placed in the proximal bulbar urethra. Robust spongiosum is closed over the graft without tension. Dorsal nerve bundles are never mobilized at all. Bleeding is controlled with gentle pressure alone. Spongioplasty is layered carefully over the repair routinely.
steps.tx: **Ventral onlay** (belly side graft) suits the proximal bulbar urethra where thick **spongiosum** (spongy cover) closes tension free over the graft. Avoid dorsal mobilization and its nerve risk. Reserve dorsal routes for distal disease, because each side has its best territory mapped.

steps.say: White scarred skin is staged to warn of lichen disease. Lichen sclerosus is diagnosed on pale atrophic patches. Balanitis xerotica obliterans is the older name still used. Dense panurethral strictures are grown slowly over years. Genital skin flaps are banned in this disease. Buccal grafts are used for every repair.
steps.tx: **Lichen sclerosus** (white scar disease), **BZO** (balanitis xerotica obliterans), scars meatus to panurethra with dense strictures. Genital skin flaps carry a **genital skin contraindication** (penile skin ban) here, because disease recurs in transferred skin. Use buccal mucosa for every repair, because mouth lining resists the disease.

steps.say: The penile urethra must never be shortened by surgery. Excision with rejoining is banned on the penile shaft. Chordee with penile shortening is staged after any transection. Substitution with buccal graft is mandated instead always. Length is guarded as function itself lifelong. Every penile stricture is grafted by rule here.
steps.tx: **Penile urethral stricture** (shaft narrowing) must never face excision, **avoid EPA** (skip cut rejoin rule), because transection brings **chordee risk** (bend with shortening). Substitution with buccal graft is mandatory for every penile case. Stage length before cutting anything, because lost length never returns.

steps.say: Failed repairs are rebuilt in staged fashion. Two stage urethroplasty is planned for complex reoperations only. Failed hypospadias cripples are included here routinely. Severe lichen disease is added as well often. The Johanson with Bracka designs are the classic options. Free grafts are laid first and tubularized months later.
steps.tx: **Two-stage urethroplasty** (staged rebuild) by **Johanson** (marsupialization stage) or **Bracka** (free graft stage) techniques rescues complex re-operative strictures, failed hypospadias cripples, and severe lichen sclerosus. Lay free graft first, then tubularize months later. Never rush to single stage salvage, because scarred beds fail again.

steps.say: Internal cuts are trusted to cure few strictures durably. Direct vision urethrotomy is offered for short soft narrowings. Long term cure is staged under ten to twenty percent. Repeat cutting after one failure is discouraged strongly. Reconstruction is planned instead of endless cuts. One failed DVIU is booked for graft referral.
steps.tx: **DVIU** (direct vision internal cut) suffers **internal urethrotomy failure** (repeat cuts fail) with cure under **10% to 20%** (ten to twenty in a hundred) long term, so repeating beyond one failure is discouraged. Refer for urethroplasty after the first failed cut. Never stack multiple cuts, because each pass deepens spongiofibrosis.
